heading: The Marginarium: how it was made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns photos into paint-by-numbers on your device; its Marginarium tells how Paul and his AI agents made it.
content_why: The chapters live in Claude Docs, which visitors without an account can't open, so GitHub is the only place they can read the full text.
avoid: Avoid showing Pip and Colophon as static decoration; each picture should show the work being done.
